verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents two official MCP servers: a CRM MCP server giving MCP-compatible agents secure read/write access to CRM data (contacts, deals, engagements), and a Developer MCP server for agentic dev tools to interact with the HubSpot Developer Platform via CLI. This directly matches the story of connecting an agent via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server's real-world reliability and setup experience beyond first-party docs.
